mapper.select: SELECT ki.id, ki.cycle_id, km.id AS master_kpi_id, km.code, km.name, km.category_id, kc.name AS category_name, km.type_code, km.calculation_rule_code, km.calculation_type_code, km.unit_code, km.is_global, ki.target_description, ki.target_value, ki.weight, ki.is_important FROM kpis_information ki INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ki.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY km.code NULLS LAST, km.name
